records.issue_text: Pagination race: offset set optimistically before findMembers(); concurrent AJAX responses can render out of order, leaving currentPage inconsistent with the member list; no re-entrancy guard on pager links
records.rationale: The diff introduces pagination that updates `model.offset` immediately in `actions.next/previous` and then fires `group.findMembers()` (admin-group.js.es6). `findMembers()` performs an async `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` and unconditionally `setProperties({ ..., offset: result.meta.offset, members: ... })` on resolution (discourse/models/group.js). There is no guarding against out-of-order responses (no request cancelation, token, or sequence check), so rapid next/previous clicks can create concurrent requests whose later/earlier arrival will overwrite `members` and `offset` with stale data.
